hero.headline: How our community works.
hero.description: We are not a bootcamp. We are an ecosystem. Here's a look under the hood at how builders grow, how projects get shipped, and what we stand for.

mechanics.title: Mentorship Pairing
mechanics.text: Every new builder is paired with a senior engineer. Mentors review code, unblock technical hurdles, and guide career decisions. You never code alone.

mechanics.title: Real Project Assignment
mechanics.text: Builders are assigned to real client projects or open-source initiatives based on skill level. No toy apps. Real stakes, real deadlines, real users.

rituals.title: Weekly Demos
rituals.text: Every Friday, builders present what they shipped. It's a high-energy session focused on celebrating wins and learning from failures.

rituals.title: Open Critique
rituals.text: Code reviews are public. We believe in ruthless radical candor with the code, but empathy for the coder.

values.title: Ship over theory.
values.text: Reading about a framework is useless if you haven't deployed it. We prioritize production over tutorials.

values.title: Leave your ego at the door.
values.text: Everyone is here to learn. The best idea wins, regardless of who it came from.

values.title: Build in public.
values.text: We share our wins, our losses, and our source code. Transparency builds trust.
